name: Neil Greiling Gardens
description: In 215 Pleasant Road, WI, Neil Greiling Gardens raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer, autumn, and spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
